name: Sri Lanka (Dominion of Ceylon, 1951–1972)
description: A yellow-bordered flag with two vertical stripes of green and orange at the hoist and a maroon panel bearing a yellow lion passant holding a sword, with a yellow spearhead in each corner of the panel.
history: Second flag of the Dominion of Ceylon, adopted in 1951 when the green and orange stripes for the Muslim and Tamil communities were added to the 1948 lion flag at the recommendation of the National Flag Committee. In the redesign of 1972, when Ceylon became the Republic of Sri Lanka, the four spearheads in the corners of the maroon panel were replaced by four bo leaves.
